deltas.subject: GAIA
deltas.current_state: Garden v15.5 uses GAIA Titanium and GAIA Diamond as named reference architectures but does not define a canonical acronym expansion.
deltas.candidate_change: Define GAIA as 'Garden Artificial Intelligence Architecture'.
deltas.rationale: Artificial Intelligence describes the full architectural scope. 'Autonomous' would incorrectly narrow GAIA to autonomous behavior even though GAIA includes safety, assurance and other non-autonomous architectural components.
non_goals: No change to GAIA Titanium behavior, contracts, safety semantics or topology.
No change to GAIA Diamond behavior, contracts, assurance semantics or topology.
No change to authority, HSA, ActionGate, DesignEpoch or canonical promotion rules.
Do not rewrite published Garden v15.5 files in place.
successor_propagation: Add the expansion at the first normative GAIA definition in the v15.6 Theories source.
Where useful for readability, render first references in User/System source as 'GAIA (Garden Artificial Intelligence Architecture)' while preserving GAIA Titanium and GAIA Diamond names.
Regenerate the complete five-file v15.6 successor candidate from the immutable v15.5 predecessor plus admitted deltas; do not patch only isolated text files.
Update glossary/catalog/reference-closure artifacts if GAIA is indexed there.

origin.decision: Use 'Garden Artificial Intelligence Architecture' rather than 'Garden Autonomous Intelligence Architecture'.

review_requirements: GSL-COMPARE/equivalence check confirming no behavioral semantic drift
